web_title: Arizona teen hailed for helping save woman with dementia wandering in 103F heat
body_text: Fourteen-year-old Royal Cothrun encountered Theresa Morgan while she struggled to walk through 103F heat in Gilbert, Arizona. He helped her into shade, contacted her family and stayed until emergency responders arrived.
trail_text: Fire crew in Gilbert to honor Royal Cothrun, 14, for helping an elderly woman who became disoriented amid a heatwave.
